thread:
sam: Scheduling enable for halley-2.1 in the catalog during the 02:00 UTC change window. Plan is staged rollout (25% -> 50% -> 100%) over ~30m. Need fallback ordering, smoke checks, and a hard escape hatch before lifting.

deploybot: [deploybot] Dry-run manifest uploaded: /deploy dry-run --catalog halley --enable halley-2.1 --stage staged --weights 25,50,100 --fallback halley-1.4,comet-13b --prelift-smoke true

priya: +1 to staged. Fallback should prefer halley-1.4 (lower latency/cost) then comet-13b. Also make sure auth 401/403s are excluded from the error signal (we hit that last time).

maria: I'll author the release note + runbook link. Please add explicit rollback commands: how to pin catalog to halley-1.4 and how to revoke the quant variant.

len: Proposing metric triggers and pin behavior:
- triggers: error_rate_excl_auth > 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95_latency > 2.5x baseline OR token_cost delta > 25%
- action: phase A (0-10m): immediate pin to halley-1.4 (no drain)
- phase B (10-40m): graceful pin with 30s drain
This keeps quick escape early but lets us do graceful switches once stable.

sam: I like that. Make the initial immediate-pin window configurable; want ops to be able to shorten in-flight.

deploybot: Policy patch applied:
```
phase_a: window=0-600s
  on_trigger: immediate_pin(variant=halley-1.4, drain=false)
phase_b: window=601-2400s
  on_trigger: graceful_pin(variant=halley-1.4, drain_seconds=30)
triggers:
  - name: high_error_excl_auth
    condition: error_rate_excl_auth > 0.015 for 180s
  - name: p95_latency_spike
    condition: p95_latency > 2.5 * baseline for 120s
  - name: token_cost_jump
    condition: token_cost_percent_change > 25
prelift_smoke: true
abort_on_smoke_fail: true
notify: ["@priya", "@sam"]
```

priya: For smoke, include a small conversational prompt, an embeddings call, and a quick reranker sample. If smoke fails, abort and ping me + sam.

maria: Release note draft (will paste to docs channel):
"halley-2.1 (staged): enabling halley-2.1 with primary fallback halley-1.4 and secondary fallback comet-13b. Pre-lift smoke tests will run; immediate pin escape hatch for elevated errors/latency during initial window. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/halley-2.1. Rollback commands included."

ops-runner: Change window confirmed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Oncall will be paged on trigger. I'll add an ops contact to the deploybot comment and stand by during the window. :thumbsup:

sam: Can we add the quick smoke commands to the manifest so deploybot runs them before each stage? Something that fails fast.

deploybot: Added pre-lift smoke snippet:
```bash
# conv sanity
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"halley-2.1","prompt":"summarize: The quick brown fox"}' | jq .choices
# embeddings sanity
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"halley-2.1","input":"sanity vector"}' | jq .data
# rerank smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/rerank -d '{"model":"halley-2.1","query":"best city","cands":["NY","SF","LA"]}' | jq .scores
```
If any of these return non-200 or unexpected shape, abort and tag @priya @sam.

priya: Perfect. Also add a small sanity that compares p0 output token length to expected to catch obvious hallucination regressions.

len: Infra LGTM. I'll be online in the window and can flip the config if we need to tighten the immediate-pin duration.

maria: I'm dropping the release notes into the announcements channel and linking the runbook and rollback snippet.

sam: Scheduling the deploybot lift at 02:05 UTC with the 5m early monitoring window. Will ping here when the job starts. Thanks team. :rocket:
